text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I head to the cafeteria to find Ines<n>Fujin walled in
by taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there, Trainer. Hehe, don't<n>mind me. I'm
just having a solo<n>taiyaki party! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yup. So what happened is, at the<n>taiyaki place
where I work...

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Stall Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Well, this is a problem. I messed up<n>the numbers
and ordered way too<n>many ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... But hey, there's always a<n>silver lining! How
about letting all the<n>part-timers practice with those
extra<n>ingredients? You can teach them how<n>to make
taiyaki like you do, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nothing would go to waste, and<n>everyone would
learn something—it's<n>two birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I ended up with a<n>bunch of these
taiyaki practice<n>leftovers from work!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, they're all jam-packed with<n>red bean paste.
♪ Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin gleefully reaches for her<n>first taiyaki.
choice_data_list: You've earned those, so eat up.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Urk. Y-yeah, maybe this portion's<n>too much for
one person. Red bean<n>paste is pretty sugary...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward to eating what<n>I'd rustled up,
but I have to learn how<n>much is too much.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll just give these away! I<n>can have
another taiyaki party and<n>invite everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heya-hey! Listen up, everybody! I'vegot some delicious taiyaki right here,and just for today, it's totally free!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And I'll tell you the taiyaki place<n>that made
these, so if you think<n>they're delish you can go get
some<n>more!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the party, the taiyaki stall goes<n>on to gain a
legion of new regulars<n>from the academy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I will! Stuff always tastes that extra<n>bit delicious
when you make it<n>yourself!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I got better at grilling taiyaki,<n>and now my
tummy's full up too...<n>This is bliss! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
By the time Ines Fujin is done<n>happily eating all the
taiyaki, there's<n>not a single crumb left.
